These are separate contracts for each chamber; the probabilities change as markets trade.As results come in, we’ll watch for surprises relative to expectations. Committee appointments, bill text and bipartisan support are the next things to watch. Clearer rules could encourage institutional participation in trading, custody and tokenization.Fiscal plans could affect financing conditions through debt issuance expectations, yields and the dollar.
